Tana zuwa gurin ta d'auki wayar ta sake buga ta da bango tana kallonsa hawaye sai tsere yake a fuskarta, Cike da d'umbin mamaki! yake kallonta kafin yace."Kina da hankali kuwa aysha."!? Cikin yanayinya tace"Ai dole kace haka dole kace haka mana idan ka kirani da mahaukaciya bai zai dame ni ba tunda nasan duk kanin abun da nakeyi inayi ne don in kare mutuncina Yanzu ashe kai maci amana ne? Wallahi ka cuce ni ."! Tafad'a tana zubewa a gurin tare da du'kunkune kanta tsakanin 'kafafunta kuka take wurjajan.'' Ganin lokacin sallah na neman wucewa ya sanya ko ta kanta bai bi ba ya bude sif a gurguje ya shirya jikinsa cikin jallabiya ruwan toka ya dauki dadduma fucewar sa yayi ya barta tana gurshen kuka.

Tana jin bud'e kofarsa  ta dago kanta da sauri nan ta hangi futarsa kwance tayi kofar toilet din tana jin kamar ta had'iyi zuciya ta mutu.

Omar kuwa bayan ya idar da sallah zaman sa yayi kofar gida yana fargar shiga cikin gidan masifar aysha ta soma damunsa.

Sai karfe tara shaura ya shiga gidan har yanzu tana kwance kofar toilet din tana abu daya don tsabar masifa dake cinta ko sallah bata tashi tayi ba.


Tsayuwa yayi kanta hannunsa zube cikin aljuhu ''Aysha"! Ta dago kanta da sauri mikewa tayi  ta kai masa duka a kirji ya rike hannun tamau!! furkarsa a murtuke yace."Me yasa kika fasa min waya kika lalata min ? wai shin me yasa ke bakya kaunar zaman lafiya ne? me nayi miki zakiyi min asara."!

Taji wani dun'kulelan bakin ciki yazo ya tokare mata ma'koshi  kokarin kwance hannunta take ya rikesu da kyau!! kallonta yake da rikittun idanunsa......Sai kin fad'a min me nayi miki sa'anan zan sake ki."

Hawaye ya sake wanke mata fuska! Lips din sa ya dan ciza sam! baya son zubar hawayen ta yana jin wani irin zafi cikin ranshi....."Kullum kuka kullum kuka bakya gajiya aysha wai me yayi zafi ne uhmm!? ki fada min menene ya faru ni dai nasan tunda na shigo gidanan banyi miki laifin komai ba."!

"Eh dole kace haka mana!! Saboda kasan baka da gaskiya ko? kaine fa kayi min alkawari baza kaje gurin waccan 'yar iskar matar ba mai abincin shine kaje waye ya san ma abunda kukayi tunda gashinan kana shigowa kayi wanka shine ta kira ka a waya take maka godiya da bangajiya Duk wanda ya cuce ni Allah ya isa wallahi." Idanunta a rufe take wannan maganar kana ganinta zaka fahimci bata cikin hayyacinta......Omar ya dinga kallonta cike da tsananin mamaki! aysha zarginsa take ? Babu shakka Nafisa ce ta kirashi lokacin yana wanka shine ita kuma ta zargi wani abu dabam!! Hannunta ya kama ya rike so yake suje su zauna domin ya fahintar da ita turjewa take ta'ki binsa labulen dakin ta rike da kyai tana dukan hannunsa wanda ya rike nata, Daukarta yayi kacokam ya kaita bed din a je babbake gurin yayi sannan ya zuba mata idanunsa masu dafi, Kasa tayi da kanta tana  goge hawayen fuskarta.


 A nutse yace."Idan na fahimce ki kina so kice kice kina zargina da aikata fasikanci ko wani abu makamancin haka da Nafisa ko da Sadiya saboda kawai naje na sallame su hakkinsu kike mana irin wannan zargin aysha kan ki d'aya kuwa? me yasa komai zakayi ke baza ki sanya hankali da nutsuwa ba a ciki ni Omar kike zargi da aikata mummunan aiki har yanzu kin kasa gane waye mijinki? Idan ni manemin matane to kema bazan tsallake ki ba da tuni wannan cikin na jikin ki mu same shi ta hanyar banza kamar yanda kika fad'a sarki cewar nayi lalata dake tun farkon lamarin duk sanda na tuno wannan rana na kan kwana ina bakin ciki  Dake bani da hakkin ku sai Allah ya wanke ni tun ba'aje ko ina ba, tabbas naje inda kike zargin zuwana amma fa ba abunda kike zargi muka aikata ba Omar ya tsani mazina ci da mazinaciya duk wani zargi da kikeyi min ki daina ki zauna dani da zuciya daya kamar yanda nake zaune dake." Cikin 'bacin rai yake maganar.

Jikinta ne yayi sanyi ita kanta yanzu kunya take ji duk sanda ta tuno da sharrin da tayi masa ta kan kasa hada ido dashi bayan hannunta ta sanya ta goge fuskarta tace"To me yasa da farko kace min bakaje ba ai da ka sani ka fada min gaskiya."

Idanunsa a kanta yace."Fad'ar bata da wani amfani a gare ki tunda zaki tada hankalin ki kamar dai yanzu gashi kina wani irin abu kamar na marasa hankali da ilimi, tunda kince bakya son zama sa yaribyar shikkenan maganata ta kare insha Allah zan nemi wata mai aikin, amma abunda kike zargi a tsakanina da ita babu shi har abadah."

Ajiyar zuciya ta sauke tana kallonsa ko kunya babu, kallon junansu suke tsawon minti biyar ya mike yana girgiza kansa rigimar aysha Allah yayi yawa da ita.

***

Da wani irin farin ciki ta tashi ajikinta take jin zai zo gidan kwana tayi tana mafarkinsa ita dai Allah ya sanya mata kaunar Sadauki har cikin ranta.

Gidan alhamdulilahi ya fara cika da baki iri-iri kamar ko wace juma'a al'majiri yara da manya musakai da guragu sunyi dafifi a harabar masallacin suna jiran a futo da sadakar da aka saba yi musu...Duk ranar juma'a.

Karfe sha biyu da minti goma suka isa gidan Jama'a sai binsu da kallo suke suna kawo gaisuwa Tafida dake can garken dabbobi ya hango su da sauri ya silale ta kofar baya ya nufi sashen kulu domin kai mata rahoto.

Omar ya tsaya yana gaisawa da jama'arsa na gidan cike da walwala da farin ciki fuskarsa a sake yake gaisawa da kowa kafin ya nufi Fada domin kai gaisuwa  Aysha kamar silalewa tayi ta gudu ganin ya shagala da gaisawa da mutane.


Rungumeta tayi tana dudduba jikinta wani irin 'kyashi da bakin ciki da bakin ciki ya cika mata zuciyarta aysha ce ta dawo tamkar dawisu saboda tsananin kyau! Tayi wata irin 'kiba mai daukar hankali fatar ta tayi luf!!! cika da kwarjinta da ayshar tayi yayi masifar daga mata hankali goshinta sai wani she'ki yake tabbas cike ne da ita don duk ga alamomi nan sun nuna.

Cikin yake take fad'in"Ayshata nayi kewarki sosai haka kika koma katuwa aysha anya wannan kibar da kikayi ta lafiya ce kuwa gaskiya ina zargin ko sanyi ne yake kumbura miki jiki dole sai na karbo miki maganin hausa saboda gashinan jikin ki ya nuna sanyi na damun ki."!!

"Mommah nima wannan kumburin da jikina yake yana damuna yanzu dai babban abun da yafi d'aga min hankali wannan jarabban kishin."!

" Kar ki damu insha Allah yau zaki rabu dashi shege d'an kaddara me za'ayi da hada zuria da irinsu."Kulu ta fada cike da kyashi da bakin ciki.

"Baiyo!!!! Ta kwala mata kira da sauri tazo ta zube gabanta " Gani ranki ya dad'e! "Ina fatan kin  tafasa min wannan sassa'ken maganin ko."!

" Eh ranki ya dad'e na tasa shi don har ya soma hucewa ma."To shikkenan tashi kiyi tafiyarki." Baiyo ta mike jikinta a sanyaye ta koma bakin aiki tana tunanin wannan mugun abu tabbas tasan aysha take shiryawa wata mugunta babu shakka ta gane maganin zubar da ciki ne ta sanya ta aikinsa. Zatayi kokarin hana hana ayshar shan maganin insha Allah, Tana kicin tana jinsu suna hira Kulu tana fad'in"Kije ku gaggaisa da kowa na gidan in yaso sai kizo ki sha maganin kafin ku tafi zai fara aiki a jikinki." Aysha ta mike ta nufi sasashen su Nanne to anan Baiyo ta samu damar bin bayanta, tana daf da shiga sashen ne baiyo ta riske ta aysha ta tsaya tana watsa mata wani irin kallo.

Baiyo ta sunkuyar da kanta kasa a nutse tace"Ranki ya dade afuwa idan babu dama ina son nayi magana dake." Mtssssw!! me yasa tun ina ciki bakiyi min magana ba sai da na futo waje ni wallahi bana son munafurci wato kin 'kunso gulma da munafurcin ki zaki zo ki fad'a min ko? to sai ki bari ko menene i dan na dawo sashen naku kya fad'a min."! Gaba tayi tana wata irin tafiya ta da kasaita.  Baiyo ta bita da kallo cike da mamaki, jiki a sanyaye ta juya ta koma inda ta futo cikin zuciyarta na fad'in"Wanda baiji bari ba..........!!

Sai da ta dai-dai ta nutsuwarta ta shiga palon bakinta dauke da sallama.Nanne da jakadiyarta suna zaune a palon suna shira suka amsa sallamarta. aysha ta karasa a nutse ta zube gaban mahaifiyar tata tana gaishe ta, Nanne ta amsa fuska a sake tana jin dadin ganin yanda ayshan ta sauya lokaci guda dama ita sam ba taji wata fargaba ba tasan duk inda namiji yake to Omar ya kai yanda ake so ko shakka batayi zai rike mata ayshar ta da amana.

aysha kam gamin Nanne nayi mata wani kallo ya sanya ta gaishe da jakadiya kamar bata so, ita kam jakadiya amsawa tayi fuska a sake don idan da sabo to ta saba sa halayyarta.

Shiru palon yayi na minti biyu Nanne ta gyara zamanta sosai tana nazarin ayshar a nutse tace"Ina fatan dai duk kunanan lafiya kuma duka wad'annan d'abi'un naki  da mugwayen halayen ki da na sanki dasu kin daina kin rungumi mijinki hannu biyu ko."!?

A hankali tace."Eh Nanne komai yace in yi masa inayi dai-dai gwargwado ni dai ta 'bangare na babu wata matsala."

Cike da farin ciki tace''To masha Allahu yanzu ke haka bai fi miki ba shi aure ni'ima gare shi aysha ki duba ki ga yanda kikayi ki'ba kika kara kwarjini gaskiya naji dadin ganin ki a haka ga alamu nan ya nuna kamar kina da juna biyu ko.''

"Nima ban sani ba Nanne."! Tafad'a tana kokarin bagarar da maganar ita a wautar ta  bata so kowa ya fahimci ciki gareta saboda idan ya zube kar wanda ya zargi wanin abun.

Nanne kuwa cikin farin ciki da nishadi tace" Aysha ciki gare ki don duk ga alamu nan sun nuna kawai dai baki da laulayi ne."

Kanta ta sunkuyar kasa tasan bin 'kwa'kwkwafi irin na Nanne dole ta gano komai......Tace"Ina fatan kin isa fada kin mika gaisuwa ko."!? Girgiza kanta tayi tana fad'in"Yanzu nake son na isa.''


Nanne ta 'bata fuskarta tace"Kusan awarku daya da zuwa amma ki kasa zuwa ki gaisa da iyayenki wato kina can gurin uwarki tana miki hud'uba ko."!

"Nanne kiyi hakuri don Allah yanzu zan isa a gajiye muka iso kuma kin san yau juma'a nasan fada a cike take shiyasa na bari sai an idar da sallah sai naje mu gaisa."


''Sai ki bari su futo daga massalaci su shigo gida cin abinci kwa gaisa  saboda kin san bayan an idar da sallah fadar cika take da mutane tana ina zaki ratse musu kece tun farko kikayi wauta."!

"Nanne kiyi hakuri."! abunda take fada kenan tana jin tsoron fadan ta."Yanzu ina mai gidan naki."!? Nanne ta fad'a tana me tsura mata idonta.


Inda-inda ta shiga yi ''Yan.....Nima ban san inda yake ba."! tafada tana sinne kanta Nanne bata kawo komai cikin ranta ba ta cigaba da koya mata dabarun zama da mutane da yanda zata kula da mijinta aysha jinta kawai take hankakinta nacan sashen kulu tana so taje ta sha maganinta tana kuma jin tsoron fadan nanne shiyasa duk ta gaza nutsuwa sai motsi take tana so tashi amma ta kasa.


Nanne ta lura da abunda take tace"Sai motsi kike nasan a takure kike a gabana kina so ki koma gurin Mommah naki ko."!? aysha tayi shiru ba tace komai girgiza kanta tayi tace"Ina fatan dai kin shiga sashen fulani kun gaisa to idan ma baki shiga ki shiga yanzu kina futa aysha kada inji labarin kin bar gidanan ba tare da kinje kun gaisa ba nasan babu irin hud'ubar da uwartaki batayi kan fulani saboda haka ni yanzu na umarce ki ki shiga ku gaisa idan kin'ki shiga kuma ranki zai baci wallahi."

Mikewa tayi tana fad'in"Haba Nanne zan shiga mana ni wallahi mommah bata yi min ko wace irin hud'uba a kanta ni kawai jina ne bai had'u da matar ba."


''Ni dai na fad'a miki  'karya kuma wace iri ce ke baki iya ba kin san yanda zakiyi ki kare kulu ba'a ta'ba kawo sukar ta a gabanki sai kin kare ta."

Murmushi kawai tayi ta zura takalmata ta futa, Nanne ta bita da kallo cike da kauna da tausayinta  Sosai tayi farin cikin ganinta cikin wadata da kwanciyar hankali.

To koda ta futa kai tsaye sashen fulani ta nufa tun kafin ta shiga ake kai mata gaisuwa idan ta ga dama ta amsa idan bata ga dama ba tayi wucewar ta.


Suna zaune kasan kafet ita dashi suna cin abinci cikin wani ma dai-daicin plate irin na silvar Fulani na gefe guda tana musu dariya rigimar Safarau ce wai lallai sai sunci abincin tare dashi, shi kam biye mata yayi duk dan ya sanya ta farin ciki da annunsha yana cin abincin yana santin abincin yake gefe guda kuma yana mamakin kwarewar ta gurin shirya abincin mai dadi da gamsarwa irin wannan.
Dambun shinkafa ne wanda yaji gyada  da zogale da kifi sukunbiya mara 'kaya yayi wani irin kyau a ido sai kamshin corry yake sosai Omar yaji dadin dambun domin yafi shekara rabonsa da yaci dambu mai dadi irin wannan Lokacin da fulani ta tabbatar masa da safarau ce tayi dambun yayi mamaki kwarai daga baya ya zage yana ci yana santi.

Cikin cokali ya d'ebo zai kai bakinsa aikuwa ya zube ba tare da tsammani ba wani ya koma plate din wani ya zube a jikinsa Safarau ta sanya dariya tana nuna shi da hannu hade da fad'in "Mamah kin ga ya zubar da abincin a jikinsa saboda santi."!! Fulani ta duba ta gani aikam itama dariya ta sanya tana fad'in " Lallai Omar abun har ya kai haka.'!? Safarau ta dinga dariya tana kallonsa shima ita yake kallo da murmushi a fuskarsa sosai ya saki yar dariya wanda tayi dai-dai da shigowar aysha palon.

Ganin abunda yake faruwa yayi masifar furgita ta sosai Omar dinta zaune durshan gaban Budurwar yarinya suna cin abinci tare cike da walwala da farin ciki ya ma manta da ita.

Saura kadan ta fad'i tayi saurin dafe bango tana jin yanda marar ta ke wani irin daurewa. rintse idonta tayi ta bude su tsaf ta zuba kan fuskar sa da take a sake kamar bashi ne wannan mutumin ba mai mugun miskalanci da daurewa.

"A'a aysha kin shigo ko to bisimillah ki shigo mana dama yanzu nake tambayar Omar ina ya baro ki."

Da 'kyar take tafiya har ta isa tsakiyar palon ta zauna kan kujera tana cije bakinta har yanzu cikinta murdawa yake....Cokalin hannunsa ya aje ya mike daga inda yake zaune kujerar da take zaune ya nufa....Safara'u kam tun lokacin da ayshar ta shigo palon ta wani sha kunu ta sunkuyar da kanta kasa har yanzu bata d'ago ba.


Zama yayi kusa da ita yana lalubar hannunta hankalinsa ya tashi ganin yanda gumi ke tsatstsafo mata kan goshinta da karan hancin ta sarai ya san halin ba'kin kishinta tabbas mai rabashi da ita sai Allah. Hannu ta zame daga nashi ba tare da ta kalleshi ba tace"Mama kin wuni lafiya fatan mun same ku lafiya."!?.

Fulani ta saki fuskarta sosai tana fad'in"Lafiya lau safarau ya gida ya jikin ki kuma ai Sadauki yace baki ji dadi ba kwana biyu sai kuma yanzu dana ganki na gane abunda yake da akwai to ubangiji Allah ya raba lafiya.''

Shine ya amsa kasa-kasa yana dan satar kallon fuskarta Fulani ta kalli inda Safarau ke zaune tace"Safarau baki ga aysha bane ."!? aysha najin mama ta ambaci safarau ta dago kanta tana kallon inda take zaune, kar dai wannan yarinyar ce 'Yar makaho ta koma haka.? Tabbas itace tafada cikin ranta babu shakka abunda yafi haka ma zasu yi ita da Omar tun kafin ta bar gidan ta san suna sa kyakykyawar alaka a tsakaninsu. Wani irin gumi take sosai kishi sai nukurkusar ta yake lallai kalmar malam baushe gaskiya ce a kan namiji inda yake cewa namiji ba d'an goyo bane......Safarau da kyar ta d'ago kanta tace"Aunty Gimbiya ina wuni kin wuni lafiya ya jikin ki."!? idan dutse na magana to tabbas aysha zatayi banza tayi mata bata ce komai ba

Fulani tace"Aysha safarau na miki magana.! Kanta ta d'aga kawai tana kokarin mikewa Ya mike da sauri! shima a hankali tace"Mama a tashi lafiya zanje in dan kwanta in huta bana jin dadin jikina."!

"Ayya! Sannu kinji ai dama sai a hankali Allah dai ya bada lafiya kije ki kwanta ki huta idan kuma kina sha'awar cin wani abu sai ki ki fad'a insha Allah zan sanya ayi miki."

"Nagode Mama."! Tafad'a tana kokarin zura takalminta Omar kam tuni ya rigata futa yana tsaye bakin kofar palon ta waje yana sauraron fitowar ta, Tana futowa suka had'a ido dashi tayi wani bal'in daure fuskarta da sauri ta shige shi ya bi bayanta sannu a hankali har suka isa sashen kulu ya tsays daga bakin kofar shiga  sai da ya tabbatar ta shige cikin sannan ya juya yau ji yayi yana shakkar ayshan sosai bakinsa yayi masa nauyi ya kasa furta mata mata ko wace kalma ya san dai ba haramun ya aikata ba yanda ayshar zata dauki lamarin yake damunsa a yanda yaga tana huci da had'a zufa!! baiyi tsammanin zata kyaleshi ba yaji dadin abunda tayi in yaso idan suka koma gida ko meye sai suyiwa juna.......Bai koma sashen fulani ba kai tsaye futa yayi harabar gidanan yana kallon masu shigowa  da futa kamar yanda ya saba duk ranar juma'a.

Aysha kam tana shiga t zube jikin kulu kukan da take boyewa ya kufce mata sosai takeyi kulu ta rungume ta tana rarrashinta "Haba aysha ba kuka zakiyi ba kiyi shiru ki fada min menene? kar ki manta fa da cewar nice Momnah! mai kaunar ki da kaunar farin cikin ki. Ni nasan dama in dai kikaje gurin Nanne sai ta 'bata miki rai tamkar ba itace ta haife ki ba a gaskiya abunda ake miki a gidanan ba'a kyautawa."

Cikin rarrashi gami da bambaki take magabar tana nuna kamar ita jadai ke son ayshar a gidan duk kowa 'kinta yake ciki kuwa harda mahaifiyarta ta asali.


"Mommah! Dole na na zubar da wannan 'kaddararan cikin na jikina don na rantse da Allah bazan haihu dashi ba munafiki ne maci amana mai fuska biyu sam baya kaunta da alkairi sai da sharri! Momnah yau naga cin amana ganin idona Nanne ta takura min dole sai naje sashen fulani na gaisheta nan ne da naje naga cin amana ta sanya su a gaba tana farin ciki da dariya Omar da wannan 'Yar makahon suna cin abincin cikin kwano d'aya sai dariya suke Mommah! kana ganinsu kasan masoya ne sai dariya suke cike da nushadi yanzu na kara tabbatar da cewar fulani bata kaunta tana daya daga cikin manya manyan makiyana masu so suga bayana ni kuwa a duniya me zanyi da fulani wallahi na tsane ta."!!Cikin fushi take maganar.

Kulu tace" Me na fad'a miki aysha ai dama ni tuntuni nasan akwai lauje cikin nad'i tuntuni nasan fulani naso ta had'a Omar da Safarau aure ne kece kike abunki na riga nasan fulani makirar macace tana so ta hada Omar da safarau aure domin ta cuzgunawa rayuwarki to ta Allah ba tata ba munafukar banza da wofi, Maganar ciki kuma ki kyaleta a hannuna nayi miki al'kawarin zubda miki da d'an banza yabi rariya."!!! mi'kewa tayi tana mita ta nufi cikin wani daki dake cikin palon.

*BINTA UMAR ABBALE*
[4/7, 5:11 PM] .: 33



Aysha wani irin kishi da haushin Omar ne ke damunta hawaye sai wanke mata fuska yake wai Omar ne yake cin abinci kwano guda da wata ba ita ba duk sanda ta tuna wannan al'amarin sai taji kamar ta hadiyi zuciya ta mutu.

Kulu ta futo daga d'aki hannunta rike da wani kwanon sha mai murfi ta zauna cikin kujera tana fad'in"Aysha ki daina kuka kinji ko idan kowa zai juya miki baya cikin gidanan to ni sai in da karfina ya kare a kanki matso ki kafa kanki ki shanye wannan maganin insha Allah kafin anjima nasan komai zai kammala."

Ba tare da wata fargabar komai ba ta karbi maganin tana kafa kanta taji wani irin hajijiya na neman zubar da ita a gurin, da sauri ta cire kanta zuciyarta na wani irin tashi.

Kulu tace"Maza ki kur'be shi ai ba wani yawa ne dashi ba nasan dama bazai miki dadi ba haka irin wannan maganin yake sai an daure ake sha."


Kanta ta sake kafawa a karo na biyu ta rintse idonta da kyau!! ta fara kur'ba wani irin d'aci! ya game bakinta ta cire kanta da sauri tana furzar da ruwan maganin.

Kulu taji kamar ta danne ta ta d'ura mata  "Momnah! bazan iya shan maganin ba wallahi zuciyata tashi take ga wani irin mugun daci."!!.


" Ashe ba so kike cikin ya zube ba tunda kin kasa sha ai komai dacin sa haka zaki daure ki sha in dai kina so bukatar ki ta biya.


Kanta ta sake kafawa a karo na uku ta rintse idonta da karfi ta fara shan maganin kanta na wani irin juyawa da kyar ta sha rabi ta cire kanta a gigice tsigar jikinta ta dunga mikewa nishi take tana dafe kirjinta wani mugun amai ne ke taso mata.

Kulu ta kar'bi kwanon maganin tana dubawa ganin tasha rabi ya sanya ta saki wani shu'umin murmushi tana kallon yanda ayshan ke wata irin zabura tana furzar da bakinta saboda daci!!! Da 'kyar ya samu ya mike zaune da ita a jikinsa ya dafe kansa yana mamakin ya akayi haka ta faru? idanunsa kwata-kwata sun rufe ya manta a ina yake jikinsa ya bi da kallo tik!! dashi a cikin gidan sirakai. ya kalleta da lumsassun idanunsa da suke a kankance dan har yanzu basu dawo dai-dai ba, harara ta maka masa ta fashe da kuka tana doke hannunsa dake rike da 'kugunta sauka tayi ta jawo vest dinta ta zura hawayen dake zubo mata ta goge ta nuna kofar fita da hannunta tare da fad'in"Tashi ka fita min a daki."!

Siririyar hanya ce mai bala'in tsayi kafin ka isa kofar futa daga gurin akwai tafiya mai tsayi, Ko da ya waigo yaga Safarau na biyo shi kawai sai ya tsaya tare da sake kudundune yaron cikin babbar rigarshi Safarau na 'karasowa gurin ya kai mata wani mummunan duka a kirji a take ta zube a gurin tana wani irin nishi!! Ya juya ya cigaba da gudu.

"Ku kuma abunda kukayi Allah yayi muku irinsa hakika kun cika azzalimai kuma mushirikai shin wai me kuke nema ne a wannan duniya da zaku aikata wannan aiki? me wannan yaron yayi muku da kuke kokarin halakar da rayuwarsa? Kulu nasan zaki aikata abunda yafi wannan tunda dama can na riga na san zuciyarki babu alkairi kullum kina nufin mutane da sharri! shin wai rashin haihuwa hauka ne don Allah bai baki ba kice wasu ma baza su samu ba? to baki isa kija da hukuncin Allah ba, Karki tunanin ban san irin shirka da tsubbace!tsubbacen da kikeyi ba nasan komai na kyale ki ne kawai kiyi iya iyawarki ki gama, nasan anyi wadanda suka fiki kuma sunyi sun gaji! Shin yanzu meye ribar abunda kukayi."!? Duk sukayi shiru kansu a kasa.....Sarki ya cigaba da cewa" Saboda haka Ke kulu har yanzu kinanan a matsayin matata don wannan abun da kikayi ba zai sanya na  karya alkawarin dana daukarwa mahaifina a kanki ba, amma kuma ki sani hakan ba zai hanani na dauki mataki a kanki ba hukuncin da zan dauka kansu Habi da Tafida Irinsa ne zai sauka kanki saboda haka sai kije ki sanarwa da aljanun naki masu taimaka miki kamar yanda kika fada kije ki sanar dasu suzo su taimake ki ko kuma suzo suyi min wata illar."!!!

Kulu kuka kawai take tana bashi hakuri Sarki yaki sauraranta kai duk gurin ma gabakidaya sun ji dadin hukuncin da Sarki ya dauka kansu.

Tafida da Habi wata irin nadama ce ta kamasu hakika son zuciya 'bacin ta nasihar da Sarki yayi musu tayi masifar kashe musu jiki sai hawaye suke sharewa.


Da rarrafe ta isa inda yake zaune tana kuka tana neman gafararsa Omar dai bai ce komai ba sai kallonta yake cike da mamakin shaidancin ta.


Sarki ya sanya aka kira masa Basamude!! wani kakkarfan bawa ne dake kula da shige da ficen cikin gidan....
Tun bayan futa Omar daga gidan Sarki ya sanya aka kawo masa shi daga can 'Kasar libiya Sarki ya 'yan tashi babu wani yare da Basamude yake ji sai labarci amma d'an zaman da yayi cikin hausawa ya sanya ya fara iya yaren hausa.


Cikin labaraci sarki yayi masa bayanin abunda zaiyi.......Basamude ya isa inda suke gurfane wata irin tsawa ya buga musu.

Kulu ta mike tsaye da sauri don ta riga taji duk abunda Sarki ya fada masa tana dan jin labarci amma ba sosai ba.


Tana kuka taje ta rirrike kafafunsa tana fad'in"Tunda kace har yanzu inanan a matsayin matarka me zai sanya kayi min irin wannan hukuncin wannan ai tozarci ne sai kace wasu karnuka kuma akun kuturo zaka sanya a samu a tsakiyar keji  cikin harabar gida sannan da shelar kowa yazo ya ganmu idan wannan hukuncin ya dace da bayi ma'kaskanta ni bai dace dani ba ranka ya dade a sassauta min."!!

Sarki ya zabga mata wani irin lafiyayyan mari wanda ya sanya taga gilmawar taurari!

Sai ta rarrafa kusa dasu Fulani Nanne da gwaggo tana kuka tana fad'in"Ku sanya baki mana ya sassauta min naci darajar aure Galadima Waziri kuna jin hukuncin da dan uwanku ya yanke a kaina ko? ashe kun manta ni d'in amana ce a gareku to idan kun manta ni ban mantaba." Surutai take da sambatu babu wanda ya kulata.

Basamude ya d'aga zabgegiyar bulalarsa ya lafta mata a gadon bayanta Kulu ta gantsare tana sakin wata razananniyar kara, cikin hard'addiyar hausar sa yace."Tashi muje 'yan uwanki duk sun kar'bi hukunci ke kin tsaya taurin kai!

Kulu ta kalleshi tana kuka wurjajan!! Sai ya kara d'aga bulalar zai lafta mata  Da sauri ta mike tana dingisa kafa ta nufi hanyar futa tana waiwayen bayanta ta ganshi ya biyo ta a baya yana zare mata jajayen  idonsa

 Wani tsukakken guri ne da aka ke waye shi da raga nan naga Basamude ya bude ya juyo fuskarsa babu rahama ko kadan ya kali Kulu da habi kana yace"Ku shiga ciki." 

Babu gardama suka shiga ya sanya mukkuli ya kulle ya juyo kan Tafida ya karada daya kofar ya hude a dukufe tafida ya shiga ciki ya rakube jikinsa Basamude ya rufe da makulli ya bar gurin.


Kafin kice kwabo Jama'ar dake gidan sun fara taruwa suna kallonsu, abunda Kulu ta tsana kenan.


Hawayen bakin ciki ya shiga zubo mata wai yau itace a cikin keji a kulle rana sai dukansu take tana kallon yanda jama'a ke nunata suna surutai kasa-kasa komawa tayi ta buya bayan Habi wacce abun duniya ya dame ta, yanzu garin son zuciya ta jawo kanta Masifa.

Cikin yan uwanta babu da wanda take shiri duk sunyi fad'a da juna ballanta taje ta rokesu su zo su bawa Sarki hakuri ya sa a saketa.


Tasan koda zata shekara basu ganta ba to babu wanda zai damu d'anta d'aya s duniya Anas tun yana shekaru goma suka rabu da ubansa dan asalin kasar Ghana ne shine ya dauke dansa a cewarsa mahaukaci shine zai bata tarbiyar yaransa.


Haka jama'a sukayi ta shigowa suna kallonsu kai harda mutanan waje haka farfajiyar gidan Sarki ta cika da yan kwallo masu yi musu hoto nayi da masu siyi musu vidio, Zuwa yamzu kulu ta soma sarewa da al'amarin don har an samu masu tsintar dutsina suna jifansu dashi suna tsine musu.


Sarki yayi addua suka shafa kana kowa ya koma sashesa Aysha na kallon lokacin da Omar yabi bayan Fulani sashenta abun yayi mata ciwo mutuka ganin yanda yake wani irin lallaba Safaraun yana rarrashinta.

Zama tayi gefen gado ta rafka ta gumi! tunani take shikkenan inda babu yarinyar da tuni Tafida yaci galaba a kansu ya jefar musu da d'a, ta juya ta kalli yaron gwaggo tayi masa wanka tsaf ta shirya shi sai kamshi yake.


Kumatunsa ta sumbuta ta goge hawayen dake fuskarta Hakika safarau ta cancani yabo da godiya a gareta amma babban abunda yake bata haushi da lamarinta shine yanda take shishshigewa Omar din shine abinda ke damunta amma kuma ta soma lurar wani boyayyan lamari a tare da Omar din wanda ada baya nuna akwai wata alakar soyayya a tsakaninsa da yarinyar amma kuma yanayin yanda ya rud'e ya shiga tashin hankali ya tabbatar mata da cewar ya damu da yarinyar mutuka kuma akwai sonta a cikin zuciyarsa.


Tana nan zaune tana sa'kawa da kwancewa Gwaggo ta shigo dakin hannunta rike da wani kwano mai zurfi irin na gidan sarauta, Ta aje gabanta tana fad'in"Gashinan yanzu fulani ta aiko miki dashi ya kamata kisha yanzu ko in dauko miki gurasa ne."!?


Ta'be bakinta tayi "Gwaggo meye a cikin kwanon."? tafada fuskarta da yanayi na damuwa.

"A'a ki bude ki gani mana."! gwaggo tafada tana karkade gadon....Kwanon ta bude kamshi ya bugi hancinta.

Farfesun kan rago ne yaji kayan hadi sai kamshi yake." 

Ajiyar zuciya ta sauke ta dangwali miyar ta lasa tana lumshe idonta, yanayin damuwar da take ciki bazai barta taji dadin farfesunan ba sai kawai ta mayar da murfin ta rufe tana ya mutse fuska.


Gwaggo ta kalleta a nutse tace"Ki daure kici abinci aysha kisha magani ki cire ko wace damuwa cikin ranki ai mungodewa Allah daya kubutar mana dashi daga sharrin masu sharri hakika wannan yarinya kulu ta isa a jinjina mata domin tayi namijin kokari kan lamarin....Yanzu nan ma kafin in shigo nan na samu labarin Sadauki ya dauketa su tafi asibiti hakan na da kyau ai gwara a duba lafiyarta

 Aysha ta bita da wani irin kallo na mamaki! Sun tafi asibiti? wai me Omar yake nufi ne? ta lura kwata kwata hankalinsa ya dauke daga kanta tun da abun ya faru bai bi ta kanta ba hankalinsa duk ya koma kan yarinyar, kawai sai taji wani irin bacin rai da takaici ya kamata

Gwaggo ta shigo da manya manya gurasa a rufe tace"Gashi da zafinta aysha daure kici."

Ta fara yaga tana dangwalar miyar farfesun tana ci tana ya mutsa fuska gwaggo ta mike ta futa.....Nan ta samu damar rufe kwanon miyar ta aje gurasar hannunta ta koma ta kwanta tana tunini zuciyarta na bata shawarar ta kirashi a waya wata xuciyar na hanata......Haka dai ta daurewa zuciyarta tana jiran dawowarsu daga asibitin tasan dole zai shigo ko dan d'ansa.



Sai kusan karfe biyar na yamma ya dawo gidan don ko da ya kai safarau asibiti ba shine ya dawo da ita ba dake tare suka tafi da Yunusa sai ya sanya su ya napep suka dawo gida shi kuma ya wuce gurin aiki, wanda da da farko yayi musu sallama ya tafi sai kuma ya samu kira daga Dr Rakiya kan lallai lallai ya kawo ayshan ta duba ta dalili kenan da ya sanya ya juya kan motar ya dawo gida domin ya dauki ayshan da kansa ya kaita saboda sanin irin gardamar ta, to sai kuma Allah yasa ya dawo akan katari ya riski abunda yake faruwa.


Sashen Fulani ya nufa domin duba jikin safarau yarinyar ta tsaya masa a ransa sosai yake mamakin namijin kokarinta da yanda  ta sadaukar da rayuwarta kansa tabbas Wannan al'amari ba zai ta'ba mantawa dashi ba.

Gwaggo Fulani Nanne suna zaune a palo suna kara tattauna maganar....Sukayi sallama suka shiga...Omar ya xube kasan kafet cike da ladabi ya gaishe su suka amsa  sunayi masa barka da zuwa.

Cikin barkwanci take maganar

Kawai sai

ya sanya hannu ya dauki Yaronshi dake motsi da cilla 'kafafu da'alama shigowarsu ce ta tayar dashi daga bacci.

Ya juyo da Sauri yace"Ina zaki kuma."!?

Yace."Zo ki kar'beshi kafin ya sha nono don da alama  ya tashi da yunwa.

Simi-simi ta karaso bakin bed din aysha ta dunga kallonta cike da d'umbun mamaki!!

A hankali ta mika hannunta ta kar'beshi aysha na kallon lokacin da hannuwan su suka had'u, Sai tayi saurin kauda kanta zuciyarta nayi mata wani irin turiri.


Yaron take kallo tana murmushi sai dadi takeji ta dago kanta a nutse tana kallon aysan dake faman watsa muguwar harara.

Ta sake maimaitawa aysha tayi mata banza.

Ta dago kanta a fusace! ta watsa masa harara!! saurin sunkuyar da kansa yayi ya sake dago kansa a karo na biyu yana kallonta har yanzu kallon banza take watsa masa.

'Yar dariya yayi kawai ya mi'ka hannunsa ya kar'bi yaronsa Safarau ta kama hanya ta fita jikinta duk a salu'be! tana kallon yanda ayshan ke watsa masa kallon banza a maimakon ya dauki mataki dariya ma yake tabd'ijam!!

" Bani da ikon dauko mai shayarwa ke nake so ki shayar dashi tunda kina raye kuma alhamdullihi kina da lafiya idan wani abu kike bukata na shayarwar sai in biyaki."

"Aysha kiyiwa Allah ki kar'beshi ki bashi abincinsa kina shiga hakkinsa fa, Idan wani abu akayi miki ai sai ki fad'a ba ki zauna kinawa mutane shirme ba."!

"Eh a kanta take saboda nagaji da wannan rainin hankalin naka."!

Sai ka fara fadamin komai sannan zan karbeshi wallahi."!

Ganin yanda yake kwantar mata da kai ne yasa zuciyarta ta fara sanyi ta sanya hannu ta kar'bi yaron ta ciro nono ta sa masa a baki.

Kici!kici yayi da fuskarsa kamar wanda bai ta'ba dariya ba ya tsura mata idanunsa masu rikitarwa kallonta yake yana so ya kassarata da kaifin idanunsa, amma da yake a shirye take sai ta kara sake damtse itama! ta rikice fuska ta tur'bune sosai suka dasawa junansu kallo kamar wasu tsofaffin karnuka!!

zumbur!! ta mike tsaye jikinta ya soma kyarma!! ta tsaya kanshi tana huci! a zafafe tace"Ai ba sai ka fad'a ba ba sai ka fad'aba dama ina so in tabbatar ne! tom nagode na tabbatar lallai d'an adam! butulu!! Bani takardar saki na."! Tafad'a tana mika masa hannu.

Aikuwa ya kama hannun da karfi ya shiga murd'ewa cike da salon mugunta!


 Daya hannunta tasa tana dukan hannunsa wanda ya rike mata hannu dashi tsananin azabah yasa idonta yayi jawur! ta dake sosai tana dukan hannunsa shi kuma ya hade duka hannunwan nata yana murd'ewa cike da mugunta.

Ya d'ago jajayen idanunsa yana kallonta har yanzu hannunta na hannunsa ya rikesu da kyau! amma yanzu ya daina murd'ewa.

Ranshi idan yayi dubu ya 'baci! ya sanya hannu ya goge miyau! din data tofa masa a fuska ya mike tsaye rumfa yayi mata ya makureta a jikin bango.


Shi kyarmar jiki! itama kyarma jiki!! Kumatunsa na wani irin motsi yace."Idan kin fasa yi min illah a rayuwata bakya tsoron Allah aysha!! akwai butulu irinki wacce bata san alkairi ba! kina da ilimi amma ba kya amfani dashi saboda tsabar son zuciya, Har kike tsayuwa a kaina kina fad'in in sake ki! Ranshi a tsananin bace yake amma dole ya tausa zuciyarsa ya rarrasheta maganar auransa da Safarau babu gudu babu ja da baya saboda bai ga abunda zaiyi ya saka mata dashi ba  kwata-kwata baiyi tsammanin aysha zata nuna bujirewarta dangane da al'amarin ba saboda itama idan ta zauna tayi nazari da tunani zata fahimci cewar safarau ta taka muhimiyar rawa a rayuwarsu, Don ya auri Safarau a cikin irin d'umbin son da yake mata babu abunda zai ragu.

"Aysha kina ta ikirarin cewa zakiyi min Illah! shin baki san idan kinyi min illah a rayuwa ba kanki kikayi wa? Na farko dai ni nasan idan kin cutar dani kafin wani ya koka kece zaki fara kokawa tunda na riga ja gane son da ki keyi min ya fi karfin baki ya fad'a sannan ko babu komai mun haihu dake idan kin cutar dani kanki kika cuta da d'anki idan zaki dauko wuka ki soka min a 'makogwaro a yanzu zan baki dama amma nasan zakiyi nadamar da baki ta'bayin irinta ba saboda haka ki kiyaye ki dunga sanyawa zuciyarki hakuri a ko wane hali....Ni Omar ba'ayi ni don mace d'aya na fad'a miki tuntuni ko bayan Safarau zan iya 'kara wasu biyu a kai saboda haka idan zaki nutsu ki nutsu ki gane son da nake miki duk macan da zan aura baza ta fiki a gurina ba Allah kadai ne yasan irin iya adadin 'kaunar da nake miki a cikin zuciyata aysha, ammafa ki sani duk da irin kauna da son da nake miki ba zai hanani na aikata sinna ba ba za ki hanani naji dadina da mace ba tunda dai ke kin kasa jiyar dani dadin dake cikin aure aysha ai ba zaki so kanki ki hanani na more rayuwata ba, Auran Safarau idan Allah ya kaddarashi a tsakanina da ita babu wanda ya isa ya hana ki zuba ido ki barwa Allah ikonshi."!


 Wani irin kallo take binsa dashi tana ji tamkar ta sha'kesa, Wai ashe wannan ranar zata zo? aure shekara guda za'ayi mata kishiya kishiyar ma da yarinya karama wacce take a matsayin baiwarta babu shakka Omar ya shammace ta! amma kuma babu komai ai idan yasan wata bai san wata ba, wallahi ta shirya tsaf zata nuna masa kuransa kan wannan cin amanar da yayi mata.

Cikin azama ta mi'ke da sauri ta bangaje! kafad'ar Azimar dake tsaye a kanta tana sirfa mata zagi hanyar futa ta nufa hawaye na ambaliya a fuskarta.

To alhmdullhi aysha ta samu domin da tashi garau ta tashi Dr ya shigo ya dubata sosai shima yayi farin ciki ganin ta sake kuma da ya dubata yaga ta rage damuwa  sai yace su Safaraun su zauna su d'ebe mata kewa........Cikin hikima da dubara irin ta mutanan da gwaggo take rarrashin ayshan da nuna mata misalai iri-iri da kuma nuna mata muhimamcin hakuri a rayuwa, Sosai nashihar gwaggon take ratsa tace"Gwaggo abubuwan da sukayi ta faruwa tsakanina da Omar na sani wallahi akwai halina yanzu nake sake gane ya rayuwa take yanzu nake da nasanin abunda na aikata a baya hakika nayi amfani da damar da na samu a baya na aikata ba dai-dai ba amma insha Allahu zan kiyaye gaba kuma zan dinga mayar da komai ba komai ba a rayuwa gwaggo yanzu bana nadamar auran Omar da kawata Azima Allah ya sanya alkairi ya basu zuria mai albarka....Tsabar tausayin aysha ya sanya gwaggo share hawaye tace"Yawwa aysha haka nake so ki zama nutsatstsiyar mace mai sanin ya kamata ina mai tabbar miki da cewar dukkanin abunda aka ginashi kan turba mata kyau hanya ta cin amana to baya wani tasiri zakiga gaskiyar lamari ya fito kinanan a zaune za'a dawo gurinki ana nadama to kinga hakurin ki yayi riba ko kuma baki sa'bi Allah ba, shi namiji idan yace zaiyi aure zuba masa ido akeyi domin a irin wannan lokacin duk abunda za'a fada masa ba zai dauka ba, ke idan kika tsananta ma auranki sai ya mutu kamar yanda ya faru akanki saboda haka irin wannan abu bama fatan ya sake faruwa a tsakaninku aysha kiyi hakuri ki kwantar da hankalinki ki koma dakin mijinki ki rungumi 'yayanki dakin mijinki shine yafi miki daraja da mutunci."

Tiryan tiryan Buba ya zayyanawa Alhaji Lado abunda ya faru shekaru a shirin da suka wuce da zuwan Abdu makaho garin Kano da yanda aka wayi gari aka ga sun makance shi da matarsa. karshe ya fad'a masa yanda ajali ya sauka a kansa ranar juma'a bayan yayi sallahar juma'a ya shaida masa tabbas maganar wannan bawa gaskiya ce Abdu yana da budurwa 'yarinya a lokacin da mutu Sarki ya rike ta ya aura mata d'ansa na cikinsa.....Hawaye Alhaji Lado kawai yake sharewa hakika Abdullahi yaga ibtila'in rayuwa da 'kiyayya irin ta 'yan uwa Abdu shine babba shi yake binsa su kad'ai mahaifiyarsu ta haifa ta koma ga mahallincin ta suka cigaba da zama cikin gidan Ubansu tare da matan mahaifinsu wanda basa kaunarsu ko kadai saboda baiwar da Allah yayi musu.



*To Asalin Safara'u Wacece ne."?*

Malam Haruna mai dala'ilu mutum ne salihi wanda bashi da wani buri a duniya face ya bautawa Allah mutum ne mai tsoron Allah da bin dokokinsa a wancan lokacin cewa akayi saboda tsabar tsoron Allah da yake yi baya iya zama sai dai tsuguno duk abunda xaiyi a tsugune yake ko da zai bada karatu ne idan kaga ya zaune to yana sallah ne ko kuma yana cin abinci sannan ance bai ta'ba kwana kan katifa ba sai dai ta barmar karauni ko kuma ya kwanta kan buzunsa har garin Allah ya waye.

Kullum bashi da magana sai dai kaji yana cewa Allah kasa muyi mu gama lafiya mu koma gareka lafiya motsi kadan zaiyi kalmar shahada.

To sai kuma Allah ya jarabce shi da shaidanun mata Kullum gidan babu zamn lafiya sun raba masa kan 'yayansa gaba suke da junansu ya zaunar dasu yayi musu fada amma babu wanda ya dauki nasiharsa suka cigaba da abunda sukeyi.


Kwatsam! Jibo Dan fulani wanda ya kasance babban abokinsa Allah yayi masa rasuwa Malam Jibo 'Yarsa d'ays tal Wanda itama kafin ya haifeta sai da ya share shekaru talatin da biyu sannan ya haifeta don har girma ya baibaye shi sannan.

Kafin Jibo ya rasu yace duk rintsi kada Asabe ta auri wani bayan abokinsa Malam Haruna shi ya aminta dashi shine zai rike masa yarsa da amana


Wannan dalilin ya sanya ana share makoki Aka daura auran Malam Haruna da Asabe wacce a lokacin take da shekaru goma sha uku a duniya.



Tofa sai rigima da tashin hankali na gidan Malam Haruna ya dawo kan Asabe suka hura mata wuta su da 'yayansu ta kurawa babu irin wacce basa yi mata suyi girki su hanata su sanya yaransu su jefeta suyi mata rashin kunya.



Malam Haruna bakin ciki da damuwar abunda iyalinsa suke wa Asabe ya sanya hawan jini ya kamashi babu wanda ya sani shi dai sai da yayi ciwonsa ya warke.....Cikin wannan hali Asabe ta haifi Abdullahi kamarsu daya da babbansa  Malam yayi ta murna da farin ciki ya dauki son duniya ya dora kan yaron  tofa wannan sai ya kara janyo tsana daga gurin iyalinsa duk sanda malam ya futa zaure su kuma sun samu damar azabtar da abdullahi Asabe da kyar ta cetonsa tana kuka tana nadamar rayuwar da takeyi a gidan sam basu da imani iyalin malam Haruna.


Abdullahi na da shekara biyu Asabe ta sake haihuwa da namiji aikuwa bakin ciki tamkar ya kashe su kan me Asabe zata zo tana haihuwa kuma duk maza ai wallahi baza su yarda ba,


Sai tashin hankalin ya koma kam mijin nasu wai dole sai ya saketa domin ba sa'ar auransa bace

Malam yace basu isa su sanya ya saki matarsa ba.

Su kuma sai suce shikkenan su zuba su gani dashi dasu suka cigaba da muzguna masa shi da Asabe da Abdullahi rayuwa tayi musu xafi sosai.


Akwar watarana da babban yaron malam mai suna Tanimu suka hada baki da mahaifiyarsa ya dauki abdullahi a boye ya fita dashi can bakin wata tsohowar rijiya ya nufa dashi rijiyar mugun zurfi ne da ita yana zuwa bai wani tunani komai ba ya jefa shi ciki ya bar gurun da sauri

Cikin ikon Allah Allah ya kawo wani magini da kurar ruwa da diro a kai da alams ruwa zai diba sai ya dinga jin kuka yana le'kawa ya hango yaro saman ruwa yana kuka.

Dake magini ne kuma har hakar rijiya yana yi kawai sai ya tattare wandonsa yayi shahada ya shiga rijiyar cikon ikon Allah ya fito dashi sa'be a kafadarsa Abdullahi na cikin kariyar ubangiji.


Take gurin ya dinke da jama'a kowa na fadin albarkacin bakinsa......Wani dattijo da ya kasance almajirin Malam Haruna ya kar'bi Abdullahi ya rike shine yaja su har kofar gidan malam din wanda shi kuma jin labarin abunda ya faru ya yanke jiki ya fadi ko ina nasa ya daina motsi sai dai ido kawai.


Tashin hankali sosai jama'ar unguwar suka shiga tare da tur da iyalin malam din domin kowa ya gane sune silar komai.


Asabe ta kar'bi yaronta tana kuka tayi masa wanka ta gyarashi ta nufu gidansu tana kuka mahaifiyar ta itace ta rarrasheta ta dawo dakinta da zama ta cigaba da kaf-kaf da yayanta.


Magani akewa malam al'marin na kara rikicewa a takaice dai malam Haruna sai da yayi shekaru uku a kwance yana jinya Allah ya dauki rayuwarsa....Wannan mutuwa Asabe akayi wa ita domin da aka share makoki korarta sukayi daga gidan ta koma gaban mahaifiyarta wacce ita kuma girma ya kamata hade da rashi  lafiya wadatacciya haka ta nufu gurin maigari domin akwatar mata hakkinta maigari yaki sauraranta saboda dama tuntuni iyalin malam Haruna sun bashi cin hanci dama dashi aka raba gado sai ya koreta ta nufi gida tana kukan bakin ciki.


Asabe ke sirfau tayi dakai tayi kuli-kuli ta ciyar da kanta da mahaifiyarta da kuma yaranta.....Tsawon shekaru goma sha biyu Abdullahi ya girma sosai sai ya fara neman na kansa to tindaga lokacin ta soma samun hutu Abdullahi zaiyi wanki da guga zai zuba shara a kura zai tura kurarar ruwa kai duk dai abunda yasan zaiyi asirinsa ya rufu zaiyi ya kawo gida a ci


Lokaci kuma yayyunsa maza su sanya shi a gaba domin dai dukaninsu basu iya sana'a ba don gadon da suka raba tuni ya kare da kyar ake ci a gidan sai suka fara jifan Abdullahi wai dole shima sai ya lalace kamarsu.......Amma da yake Allah baya basu sa'a asirinsu baya kamashi.


Uwani mahaifiya ga Asabe Allah yayi mata rasuwa mace ma kishin kanta da kaunar iyalinta hakika Uwani ta taka muhimiyar rawa a rayuwar su shiyasa data mutu sukayi kuka sosai.


Abdullahi da dan uwansa Lado suka cigaba da neman kudi babu ganda da son jiki kafib kice kwabo sai aka fara kawo musu tallan 'yan mata ko suna so a garin abun burgewa ne ka aurawa yarka namiji manemi mai sana'a.........Abdullahi ya amince da zai auri wata yarinya domin ya yaba da tarbiyarta da kuma gidan da ta fito a take ya kai kudi  aka sanya rana mahaifiyarsa tasa albarka sosai cikin lamarin.


Jin Abdullahi zaiyi aure ya zauna a gidan kansa yasa 'yan uwansa kowa ya fito da abunda yake boyewa domin su sabauta masa rayuwa kowa da irin asirin da yake masa saboda kawai tsabar kiyayya gami da kin gaskiya.



Ranar da aka daura aure aranar abdullahi yaji kwata-kwata baya sha'awar zama a cikin garin dare nayi bayan 'yan kai amarya sun watse ya rike hannunta kamar wanda ake ruruwa wuta a jiki suka nufi tasha ba tare da yasan ina zashi ba kawai suka shiga motar da ake lodi zuwa kano.....Wannan shine dalilin da ya kawo Abdullahi makaho garin kano da zama


 *******

Tunda aka wayi gari aka ga babu Abdullahi  cikin gari da matarsa sai hankalin mahaifiyarsa dana dan uwansa ya tashi sosai suka shiga nema dangin Rahamu amarya ma suka shiga tashin hankali gari ya dauka an nemi Abdullahi da amaryarsa an rasa a gari.

Labari ya samu su Tanimu dadi kamar su zuba ruwa a kasa su sha dama sunyi masa kurciya ne ya bar garin gabadaya kuma baza su daina jifansa ba har sai sunga ya daina motsi a duniya.


Har cikin garin kano sai da Asabe da Lado suka zo su gama bunkicen su basu labarin wanda ya ga su Abdullahi ba haka suka koma garinsu cikin damuwa da tashin hankali wannan shine mafarin kwanciyar asabe ta dinga ciwo aka rasa meke damunta ta rame ta lalace kullum cikin kuka da kiran sunan danta Abdullahi damuwa tayiwa Lado yawa shima sai ya koma kamar wani zautacce.....Bangaran su Tanimu farin ciki suke sosai da faruwan al'amarin sunyuwa Abdu kurciya sannan kuma lado ya samu ta'bi kwakwalwa burinsu ya cika.


Ranar Asabar Lado yaje gurin sana'ar sa ya dawo yana shiga gida ya tadda gawar mahaifiyarsa Asabe rai yayi halinsa.....Ya dinga fadin kalmar innalilhi wa'ina ilahi raji'un!


Jama'ar unguwa da 'yan uwanta  suka sallaci gawar aka kaita gidanta na gaskiya sati biyu da rasuwarta Lado ya tattara koma ya bar garin shi kuma sai ya nufi jahar Bauchi ya cigaba da sana'oin sa.

To wannan al'amarin da ya faru yayiwa su Tanimu dadi kawai sai suka kira dilallai suka sanya su siyar gidan da Asabe ta gada daga gurin mahaifinta wanda gidan kuma ya kasance gadon su Abdullahi ne a maimakon maigari ya tsawatar harda shi a cikin masu kasafin kudin gidan 'Yan uwan Uwani da suka rage a unguwar sukayi shiru domin suna jin tsoro suyi magana maigari ya koresu daga garin....Haka Tanimu da maigari suka kasafta gudin gida kowanne ya tashi da kaso me tsoka.

Shi kuwa Abdullahi yana kan hanya ya dawo daga nema guguwar ta fara a maimakon ya 'boya kamar yanda yaga mutane nayi sai kawai ya cigaba da tafiya yana sauri ya isa gida.....To shima irin abunda ya fada idon Asabe shine ya fada a idonsa sai kawo shi gida akayi baya gani.....Wannan shine mafarin makancewar iyayen Safarau wanda tun daga lokacin ta zama 'yar jagora.

Alhaji Lado ya dinga bawa Safara'u labarin danginsu da mahaifin su Malam Haruna Mai dala'ilu mahaifiyarsu Asabe da irin wahalhalun da suka sha da yanda 'yab uwa suka tsangwa me su har sai da sukayi nasarar barinsu mahaifar su.

Safa kuka take sosai tana tausayawa musu gaskiya idan hakane sun sha wahalar rayuwa ba kamar babanta tunda shi Alhaji Lado yana zuwa garin bauchi Allah ya hadashi da wani attajirin mutum mai kaunarsa shine ya dorashi kan harkoki na kasuwanci har ya tsaya da kafafunsa yazo yayi kudi na ban mamaki 'karshe Alhaji Kabir din ya aura masa 'yarsa Tun daga lokacin wahalarsa ta yanke sai ya shiga neman d'an uwansa Abdu babu dare babu rana sai yanzu Allah yayi ikonsa ya samu labarinsa ashe ma baza su gana da juna ba tunda tuntuni Allah ya dauki ran abunsa.

Kwanakin su Alhaji Lado Hud'u a masarautar kano suka gane lallai masarautar ta bambanta da sauran masarautu saboda karamcinta da yanda ake gudanar da mulki cikin tsari da adalci domin kullum a fada suke zama suna kallon yanda take tafiya sai dare suke shiga masaukinsu.......Da safe kafin su fita Safarau zata shiga su gaisa da juna suyi hira yan uwa a gaskiya sunga karamci da yanda ake tattalin ba'ko a masarautar sunga abubuwan tarihi sosai domin Omar da kansa ya dinga zagawa dasu kofofi da tsofaffin dakuna da suke da abubuwan tarihi a ciki suka dinga yin hotuna a gurin domin tarihi.......Tsaf suka shirya tafiya Safarau ta tubere wai sai sun kara kwana uku sun cike sati guda Alhaji Lado da baya son fushin Safarau sai ya amince suka cike kwana ukun ana ya gobe zasu tafi Safarau tana manne dasu taki sauraron Omar wanda shi kuma a lokacin fitinar sa ta motsa masa sosai gashi gefan aysha ita kuma ta bud'e wuta ta kulle duk wata 'kofa da zata sada shi da ita  idan ya shiga sashen Nanne ma sam bata bari su had'u Idan ya fake da cewar 'yayansa yazo dubawa sai ta sanya a dauko masa su ya gansu iyakacinsa Palo sam bata bari ya shiga dakin aysha ta kasa ta tsare a palo ita kuma ayshan na daki ta sanya key.

"Aikuwa yanzu ma ai zaki iya zuwa gobe da safe da wuri zasu tafi."

Da jin wannan daddan labari sai gwaggo da Nanne Fulani Wannan karon harda Kulu da ta zama mujiya a cikinsu suka shirya tsaf direba ya daukesu suka nufi gidan Omar din domin su gano dan jinjiri.


Albarka da yabo ta ko wanne fanni aysha tasha daga gurin iyayenta Kulu sai ya'ke takeyi tana binta da kallo cike da sha'awa ita kuwa aysha bata nuna mata komai ba yanda ta sake da iyayenta haka ta sake da Kulu suna hira 


Sai bayan sun tabbatar da lafiyar Safarau da jinjirinta sannan suka dawo gida cike da farin ciki mussaman Fulani da Nanne da abun yafi shafa.



Sai bayan sallahr isha'i ya samu labarin haihuwar daga bakin mahaifiyarsa Farin ciki mara misaltuwa ya shiga lokacin da ta sanar masa ya zube a gurin yayi sujjada ta godiya ga Allah. Kai, tsaye ya nufi gidan domin yaje yaga baiwar da Allah yayi masa Safaraun sa amanarsa ta haihu tarw da taimakon aysha wacce ta zama rayuwarsa gabadaya shi kuwa wane irin tukwuci zai yi wa aysha tabbas ta sake samun wani matsayi mai girma a cikin zuciyarsa.

Safarau tayi murna da farin cikin ganin Kawunta da matarsa gami da 'yayan uwanta  bangare guda suka yada zango har sai da akayi suna sannan suka koma gida cike da murna da farin ciki Yaron Safarau yaci sunan Maimartaba Sarki Salisu aikuwa yaron ya samu gata gami da kyautuka ta ko wane fanni..........Safa ta cigaba da wanka tana kula da yaronta Jakadiyar Mama Fulani itake dauwainiya da ita Aysha na dan taimaka mata da wani abun....Kullum zaka same ta a sashen Safaraun sai yamma take komawa nata Yanda suke gudanar da zamantakewar su ko kai wanene sai kayi sha'awar su .



Safarau nayin air'bain ta gudu bauchi ta bar aysha da kewa Ita sai ta tsiri zuwa gida yau idan ba taje gidan sarautar ba to gobe sai taje Omar kam yana son suk abunda take so  shiyasa baya hanata wataran ma shi da kansa yake kaita kafin ya wuce aiki idan ya dawo yaje ya daukota su dawo gida.....Kullum sai sunyi waya da Safarau da rana da dare sannan take jin dadi to bangaran Safarau ma hakane duk kewar aysha da mijinta ya isheta sati biyu kacal tayi tace gida zata dawo da kyar Hjy Abida ta rarrasheta ta hakura ta kara sati guda to a cikin satin ne suke je can garin iyayen nasu Safarau taga dangi dangi suka ganta masu kuka nayi masu mamaki nayi wai dama ashe zasu ga jinin abdu a duniya Allah kenan.....Lokacin da zasu dawo suka hado mata tsaraba iri-iri irin ta kauyw sukace sunanan zasu zo suga dakinta kuma su gaisa da Sarkin Kano Salisu.



Koda suka isa bauchi kwana biyu kacal ta kara tace gida zata koma ita Alhaji Lado ya dinga rarrashinta ta tubure dole ya shirya da kansa ya dauketa a mota ya kai ta har dakinta kana ya dawo gida cikin iyalinsa.


Ranar da ta dawo Aysha tayi ta murna suka rungume juna Aysha ta dauki Al'amin tana fad'in"Me kike bashi a can ya girma haka." Safa tace"Auntyna kenan me kuwa nake bashi nono ne kawai wallahi yaron akwai tsotso sai ya kwana da nono a bakinsa baya gajiya."


Aysha tayi dariya tace."'yan uwansa masa haka suke da wannan tsotson.



Omar da wuri ya dawo gida amarya Safarau ta dawo ya barje guminsa Aysha kam dama tunda taga ya dawo da wuru tasan abunda yake wa ta dinga zabga masa harara ko kunya bayaji sai rawar jiki yake


Itama Safaraun ta gane abunda yakewa kawai sai ta shareshi ta nemi guri ta zauna suna ta hira da Ayshan da yagaji da saka musu baki cikin hirar kawai sai ya mike ya barsu dakin aysha ya shige ya kwanta bacci ya daukeshi.


Aysha ta kalli Safarau a nutse tace"Ina fatan dai kin shirya kanki sosai da sosai ko? domin wannan mutumin yanda na lura dashi yau zai fatattaki duba ki gani don Allah har da dawowa gida da wuri."


Safa tasa dariya tace"Wallahi aunty ni babu wani shiri da nayi nima na lura dashi kai!!!! Ni ban ta'ba ganin mutum mara hakuri ba irinsa ba wallahi."


Aysha ta mike da kyar! tace"Ina zuwa."


Dakinta ta shiga ta tarar yayi rashe rashe a kwance ya kasa bacci domin da ya fara zai mafarki gashi yana sex sai firgita ya bude ido Saurin kauda kai tayi ta fara duba abunda ya shigo da ita dakin......Ya mike ya isketa inda take tsaye ya rungumeta kam yana sansanata tunda cikinta ya tsufa ta daina sakar masa jiki shiyasa sha'awa tayi masa yawa.


Cikin kulawa tace"Kaje  gatacan ta tafi part dinta nasan abunda ke damunka kenan."


Girgiza kai yayi yace."Na hakura Ayaha naga kamar zan takura mata in bari ta huta gajiya ko."?


Harara ta watsa masa.....Sai yasa dariya yana shafa sajansa tace"Kaine zaka hakura wallahi ko suma kaga tanayi a yanda kake a haka sai ka biya bukatarka.....Yace."Banda suma dai aysha wai me kika daukeni ne."!? Tana tafiya tace"Abunda ka dauki kanka."


Murmushi kawai yake yana binta da kallo har ta fice daga dakin.



Wani magani ne na mata mai kyau ta bata tace "Kina zuwa sashen ki ki hada da madara kisha insha Allahu kafin awa guda maganin zai bi jikinki karki yarda ya kusance ki har sai kinji sauyi a jikinki."


Safarau ta karbi maganin tana godiya ta nufi part dinta


*****


Yunusa da Ashiru sun dawo gidan Omar da zama inda Tsohowar mai'aikinsu Nafisa itama ta dawo gidan da zama bangaran su Ikilima kenan, suna zaune cikin kulawar mai gayya mai aiki a haka har soyayya ta shiga tsakanin Yunusa da Nafisa Ikilima da Ashiru Omar yaji dadin kasantuwar wannan al'amarin sai ya zame musu uba jagoransu sai da ya tabbatar da ya kulla auran sannan hankalinsa ya kwanta gidaje masu kyau ya siya musu ya zuba musu komai na more rayuwa kana ya basu jari ko wanne ya nemi na kansa ya tsaya da kafafunsa.....Yunusa da Ashiru suka rasa bakin godiya addua da fatan nasara kawai suke masa....Omar yasa aka kawo masa wasu sabbin ma'aikatan. 



Rayuwa kenan duk abunda yayi tsanani maganinsa Allah kuma dukanin mugun halin mutum tilas zaka same shi da kyakykyawan hali ko guda daya ne......Aysha yanzu ta zama kamilar mace cikakkiyar mace mai dattako ta zama garkuwa a gidan Umarulfaruk Aysha ta zama garkuwa ga 'yar uwarta Safarau wance ta dauke a matsayin 'yar uwa ba kishiya ba rayuwa sukeyi mai tsabta da inganci.


Aysha ta haifi yara shida hudu maza biyu mata.

Abdullahi Sa'adatu Safarau Ahamad Wanda yaci sunan mahaifinta galadima tana kiransa da suna (Danbaiwa) Sai kuma Usuman da yaci sunan Waziri Suna kiranshi da (Magajin gari) sai aunta Sunusi mai sunan tsoho kenan shi kuma suna kiranshi da (Fahat) Safaru kuma irin haihuwar ra'kuma takeyi domin bayan haihuwar  Mai sunan Sarki Salisu sai da tayi shekara bakwai kafin ta sake haihuwar da namiji inda Omar ya sanya masa sunan Kawu Lado wato Al'amin......To yanzu haka karamin ciki gareta tana ta burin ta haifi 'ya mace.



Bayan shekaru goma da suka wuce. Wadata da kwanciyar hankali ta samu a gidan Omar inda ya tattara kan iyalinsa suka nufi kasa mai tsarki domin suyi addua ga Allah da ya rayasu yayi musu ni'ima da ba kowa yake wa irinta ba......Satin su uku a kasar saudia sukayi nufo gida cikin aminci da yarda da juna.....A washe garin ranar da suka dawo aka tashi da Azimi sai suka fara ibada da tsarkakkiyar zuciya duka suka mika lamuransu ga Allah......Babu ranar da zata zi jama'a basu dafifi da kafa layi a kofar gidan Omar ba suna kar'bar sadaka ta abinci ta suttura ta kudi da sauran abubuwan bukata Addua daga bakin mutane Omar da iyalinsa suna samu al'amarin dai sai godiyar Allah.
